decisions.reason: The minimum quantity lubrication line is close to the firm's core fluid-handling offer and comes in several models, and the firm is growing in an expanding industry, so it has the slack to carry it while there is no evidence of a shortfall that would prompt problemistic search.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter fits the firm's modular filtration platform and serves machine-tool customers, and with the firm expanding and no sign of underperformance against aspirations, management has little reason to withdraw it.
The gravity band filter is a standard, close-to-core item that uses existing manufacturing and spare-parts resources, so satisfactory results and available slack favour keeping it.
